captions.start: Arms by your sides, palms forward

steps.text: Stand or sit tall with your arms by your sides, palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands up. Keep your upper arms still against your body.
Bring your hands towards your shoulders, as far as is comfortable.

safety: You can hold a light bottle of water if it feels easy.
Stop if your elbow or shoulder hurts.

mistakes.label: upper_arm_moves
mistakes.wrong: your upper arm moved away from your side
mistakes.right: Keep your upper arms still against your body.

mistakes.label: body_swing
mistakes.wrong: you rocked your body back to help lift
mistakes.right: Keep your body still; do not rock back to lift.
